subject: Medicore: data guardrails, EU storage & retention controls - technical asks
messages:
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@medicore.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@medicore.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jan 2028 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Questions on tenant-level retention & EU-only storage for regulated datasets

Hi Neha / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Medicore's compliance and procurement teams reviewed the session and have a couple of specific technical asks before we proceed to legal/procurement. Our deadline to confirm technical fit is Jan 20. High-level asks: 

- Ability to enforce retention windows per tenant/workspace (we need the ability to lock a 7-year retention for PHI-related projects).
- Guarantee of EU-only at-rest storage and keying (customer-managed KMS preferred).
- Auditable deletion proof (shredding logs + authoritative timestamp) when retention expires or a legal hold is released.
- A simple mapping of which API/console options we’ll use to configure those controls (we have both platform administrator and tenant admin roles).

I've attached our compliance checklist and SOC2 excerpt. Can you confirm whether these are supported today, what’s on your roadmap, and the expected timeline to ship tenant-level retention enforcement and EU-only storage options?

If useful, procurement is happy to coordinate a short working session next week to create a mutual action plan.

Best,
Sara
Sara Lin
Lead, Compliance
Medicore Health

Attachment: medicore-retention-checklist.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)
Attachment: soc2-section-5.pdf (PDF, 18 KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@medicore.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, procurement@medicore.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jan 2028 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Questions on tenant-level retention & EU-only storage for regulated datasets

Hi Sara — really appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front: we support region-bound storage today (configurable at workspace level) and have SOC2 artifacts available; tenant-enforced immutable retention is not GA today but is on our roadmap and we can outline a path to meet your 7-year requirement.

Follow-ups / proposed next steps:
1) Internal alignment: Karthik and Marissa, can you confirm the minimal implementation scope to give Medicore a compliance-grade tenant retention lock (config API + audit trail + proof-of-deletion)?
2) KMS: Medicore prefers customer-managed keys in GCP EU regions. Karthik, do we have a supported KMS integration surface for private deployments or Redwood Dedicated?
3) Timeline and MAP: Sara — are you ok with a mutual action plan where we scope a Dedicated/private deployment pilot + delivery milestones over a 6–10 week window? Procurement indicated they prefer a pilot ahead of a full commitment.

I’ve attached a short tenant-spec sheet to show the config knobs we think will be needed. We can spin up a 30-min technical call next Tue/Wed.

Thanks,
Neha
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: tenant-retention-spec.xlsx (XLSX, 12 KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: INTERNAL: scope + effort estimate for tenant-level retention lock (Medicore)

Team — bringing this internal so we can be crisp for the MAP with Medicore. Quick background: Medicore needs tenant-level retention enforcement that cannot be changed by tenant admins (platform-level lock), EU-only at rest with CMK, and verifiable deletion proofs. Procurement wants pilot before legal signs.

Questions / asks for Engineering/Product: 
- Minimum viable feature set to claim "tenant retention lock": config API to set retention bounds (min/max), an immutable platform flag to prevent tenant override, audit log events for retention-governed deletions, and a signed deletion certificate on completion. Any gaps?
- KMS surface: do we require Dedicated/Private for CMK-based storage guarantees or can hosted customers use CMEK in our hosted EU region? If only Dedicated/Private, we need to be explicit to Medicore.
- Rough ETA: can we provide a triage estimate (S, M, L) and a tentative 1st delivery milestone (prototype + audit log) within 6 weeks?

Action items I’ll own: create MAP draft, coordinate Medicore pilot dates, and prepare compliance artifacts they requested. Karthik/Marissa — can you please reply with estimates and any blockers by EOD tomorrow?

Neha

Cc: procurement@medicore.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jan 2028 15:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Questions on tenant-level retention & EU-only storage for regulated datasets

Neha — thanks for the fast reply and the spec. Procurement is happy to do a pilot and has penciled in Jan 30 for a 2-week technical pilot window. Legal wants to see the MAP and a KMS deployment option (CMEK vs Dedicated CMK) before Jan 22.

Let's lock a 45-min call on Jan 18 to run through the MAP and the config UI/API we’ll use to enforce the retention lock. I’ll share a DocuSign link for the pilot SOW once we align on technical bits.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Sara
